method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING.md §6.5 manual validation (run_loop.py uses select(), broken on Windows per §6.4). FULL RE-RUN 2026-06-11 against the read-framed description (HCBR-2026-06-11-03 fix: 'Author or interpret', read-side audit cases, 'before writing or reading' closing): all 20 original queries re-measured + 6 new (q21-24 read-side should-trigger incl. the verbatim field-failure task; q25-26 read-shaped should-not near-misses). Empirical step = independent fan-out of 26 fresh-context agents, one per query, each shown a neutral menu of 9 skill descriptions (SPID at C among realistic siblings, NOT flagged as under-test; sibling authoring skills shown with abridged versions of their own new read-framed descriptions, matching deployment) + one query, asked which ONE skill to load (or NONE) + reasoning. Anonymized per feedback_skill_trigger_eval_fanout; agents told to judge ONLY the menu, use no tools beyond reading it, and ignore environment skills. Verdicts adjudicated from each agent's REASONING + pick. Menu: A=SkyPatcher edit-record-fields, B=KID keywords-to-items, C=SPID distribute-to-NPCs [under test], D=CID items-to-containers, E=mutagen-reference record-schema, F=crash-diagnostics, G=conflict-resolution, H=papyrus-reference, I=modding-basics. Menu + raw run-record in dev/skill-validation/2026-06-11-read-triggers/ (private). Supersedes the 2026-06-02 run (whose 20 queries are q1-q20 here, all verdicts reconfirmed).

result.notes: All 14 should-trigger picked C — the 10 originals (write-side, reconfirmed) and all 4 new read-side cases: q21 is the VERBATIM HCBR-2026-06-11-03 field-failure task ('check Authoria - Modded Outfit Distribution... assigning an outfit to NPC- Mjoll', _DISTR.ini context) which the old write-framed description missed; q22 what-does-this-_DISTR-do; q23 does-it-affect-Serana/unique-filter; q24 audit-why-no-distribution. Agents explicitly cited the new interpretation clause ('asks what an existing _DISTR.ini does, whether a given NPC is targeted by it'). All 12 should-not routed elsewhere, incl. the two new read-shaped near-misses: q25 (read-only SkyPatcher-ini-on-NPC question → A: agents keyed on framework, not read-verb) and q26 (read a Papyrus script for NPC spell adds → H: artifact type beats 'spells to NPCs' phrasing). Hard originals all held: q18/q19 name SPID but are install/conceptual → I; q20 runtime-mass-edit on ITEMS → A. Every manual_predicted_trigger matched the measured verdict.
result.peer_review: Author prediction + 26 independent fresh-context agents (exceeds §6.5's 'one peer reviewer checks 3 random'). Re-run required by PR #42 independent review (stale-eval blocking finding). Aaron may spot-check any query.
result.carry_forward: KI-S5-V1X-1: re-run on the next release that ships a Windows-compatible eval runner (run_loop.py select() fix), per §6.4.

revalidation_2026-07-28_294.method: 2026-07-28 revalidation for issue #294 (all 13 descriptions compressed to the amended section-3.5 200-400 char target): section-6.5 fan-out, one fresh-context sonnet (low effort) agent per query, each shown the full lettered menu of all 13 NEW descriptions (under-test skill unflagged, letter E) plus NONE, asked which ONE to load; one opus adjudicator per skill scored from reasoning per section-6.5 step 4. No fable-model agents. Conductor session: #294 worktree.

misses.query: give a faction to all dead draugr and make it deterministic so it's the same across saves
misses.diagnosis: SkyPatcher's description claims 'change NPC stats/factions/inventory' as a no-ESP runtime edit, which collides head-on with SPID's faction distribution; E's distinguishing hook for this query (the deterministic '!' chance) sits at the very end of a long filter list and lost to B's earlier, plainer faction claim.

misses.query: i'm brand new to skyrim modding, can you explain what SPID even is and whether i need it
misses.diagnosis: E owns the literal token 'SPID' and states no scope boundary excluding conceptual/beginner 'what is it / do I need it' questions, so naming the tool alone pulls the skill even with no ini to write or read.

revalidation_2026-07-28_294.adjudicator_notes: Recall 13/14 (0.93) and specificity 11/12 (0.92); both above the 0.80 / 0.50 bars, so PASS. No reasoning-vs-pick overrides were needed — every agent's reasoning matched its pick token, including both misses (row 10 reasoned explicitly toward SkyPatcher, row 19 reasoned explicitly toward SPID-as-topic). Row 19 is a soft miss: the pick is defensible on the user's behalf (E is the only SPID knowledge in the menu), so tightening for it risks recall — the more useful fix is row 10's overlap with SkyPatcher's 'change NPC factions' claim, addressable by lifting E's deterministic-'!' and 'to NPCs' framing earlier or adding a one-line boundary in B's description that faction *distribution* to a filtered NPC population is SPID. E's existing boundary sentences ('keywords on ITEMS are KID', 'editing a record's own fields is SkyPatcher') worked well: rows 11, 12, 20 and 25 all routed away cleanly, and 20 (runtime enchantment on all iron swords) resisted the 'runtime, no-ESP' phrase E shares with B/J.
revalidation_2026-07-28_294.contamination_audit_2026-07-28: 2026-07-28 PR #295 review follow-up (contamination audit): the independent review found adjudicator notes quoting text that exists only in the PRE-compression descriptions. Forensics on the run journal established: (a) judges were shown the NEW menu (the loader agent's journaled return contains it verbatim); (b) 11 of 281 judge rows leaked OLD description text from the agents' own environment skill listing (the installed plugin) into their reasoning; (c) separately, some opus adjudicator notes confabulated 'verbatim quotes' from that same stale environment. All contaminated rows were re-judged with a hardened prompt (explicit stale-environment warning): 15/15 confirmed their original verdicts, except dialogue-authoring q19, whose recorded MISS was itself a contamination artifact and is overturned. Treat quoted description text in the run-1 adjudicator_notes above as unreliable where it does not appear in the shipped description; scores are pick-derived and were confirmed by the hardened re-run. Skill-specific: q11 and q16 rows re-judged hardened: unchanged (J; D). The 'who wins contested records' text that had attracted q16's route exists again in the reworded bulk-record-jobs description, so the route is now supported by shipped text.
